title: Favored
summary: FA'VORED, participle passive 1. Countenanced; supported; aided; supplied with advantages; eased; spared. 2. adjective Regarded with kindness; as a favored friend. 3. With well or ill prefixed, feature

inlines.v: FA'VORED, participle passive 1. Countenanced; supported; aided; supplied with advantages; eased; spared. 2. adjective Regarded with kindness; as a favored friend. 3. With well or ill prefixed, featured. Well-favored is well-looking, having a good countenance or appearance, fleshy, plump, handsome. Ill-favored is ill-looking, having an ugly appearance, lean. See Genesis 39:1. Genesis 41:3. etc. Well-favoredly, with a good appearance. [Little used.] Ill-favoredly, with a bad appearance. [Little used.]
